airport.claim: Noida International Airport at Jewar began commercial flights on 15 June 2026. International flights were not yet running in the latest reports we found.

sources.title: Noida International Airport to start commercial flights from June 15 (Business Today, May 2026)
IndiGo to begin commercial flight services from Noida International Airport from June 15 (News on AIR)
Noida International Airport opens for commercial flights (Wego)

aquaLine.claim: The Aqua Line extension into Greater Noida West now targets a 7.5 km first stretch from Sector 51 to Kisan Chowk (Sector 4) with five stations, awaiting approval as of July 2026. The earlier plan ran to Knowledge Park 5; that leg is not in the current first stretch.

sources.title: Noida Metro Aqua Line extension: 7.5 km, 5 new stations (Business Today, July 2026)
UP cabinet approves DPR for 17.4 km Aqua Line linking Noida Sector 51 to Knowledge Park 5 (Swarajya, 2024)

ukLandLaw.claim: Uttarakhand's 2025 land law bars people from outside the state from buying agricultural or horticultural land in 11 districts, including Nainital. Residential land purchases by outsiders are capped at 250 sq m per family, with an affidavit.

sources.title: Uttarakhand bans outsiders from buying agricultural, horticultural land in 11 districts (ThePrint, 2025)
Uttarakhand Assembly clears bill to restrict outsiders from buying agricultural land (Scroll)

upReraAds.claim: UP RERA requires project ads and brochures to show the registration number prominently (not hidden in a disclaimer), the UP RERA website, and the project's QR code.

sources.title: UP RERA directs promoters to publish QR code in all brochures and ads (Housing.com News)
UP RERA issues project advertisement guidelines (Housing.com News)
